card.fires_on: The pole responds to the second part of "U.S." or "United States" in running web text, right after "U" or "United". It also fires weakly on a few other mid-name or linking words such as "it" in "what it takes" or the end of "Smithson" and "Federer".

modes.description: The ".S" piece in "U.S." before a noun such as presidents, Muslim workers or Naval Academy.

modes.description: The word "it" after "what" or "while", or the end of a surname.

card.writes: It promotes words that link a noun to a following participle or relative phrase, such as "-produced" and "associated", and suppresses Chinese "的" compounds.
card.plain: It lights up on the last part of "U.S." or "United States", when a country name is being written out.
